title: Settle the islands
text: Place huts on the corners of the islands and join them up with bridges.

title: Roll for cargo
text: Each turn, roll the dice. Every island showing that number pays its cargo to the huts beside it.

title: Trade
text: Offer swaps to everyone from your phone, or trade with the bank and harbours.

title: Build
text: Spend cargo on bridges, huts, lighthouses and charts. Huts are worth 1 point and lighthouses 2.

title: Watch the squall
text: A roll of 7 brings the squall. Big hands drop half, and the roller steals a card.

title: Win
text: First to the target score on their own turn wins: 7 in a quick game, 10 in a full one.
